prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Sevrin Inkseal. Character visual motifs: exhausted court magistrate in layered burgundy robes and a huge tablet pauldron, carrying a multi-headed law stamp; no Death Prophet or Silencer-style global silence.
TOP LEFT: Case Law. Ability concept: observes completed enemy skills within 120 GU and records their declared **server-side category** (`mobility`, `attack`, `protection`, `control`). Only one last category per target, lasting 4 s; does not read hidden cooldowns or private abilities.
TOP RIGHT: Mark Jurisdiction. Ability concept: stamps a 70-GU public court disk around a visible 2-HP breakable ink pillar for 3.5 s. Opponents may enter and cast normally. A champion's **second completed skill of the same category** inside the disk receives 0.25 s post-cast recovery, once / target / disk. A different category resets its local repeat count.
BOTTOM LEFT: Appeal Granted. Ability concept: relocates an existing court center up to 45 GU after a 0.45 s warning, or if targeting an ally inside, erases **one** pending cast-recovery tax on that ally. Does not silence or imprison anyone.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Precedent Review. Ability concept: for 4.5 s expands one active court to 125 GU and publishes the current recorded category above every participating enemy. If an enemy repeats the same category a third time, they take one **small shield-stripping hit** and 0.35 s post-cast recovery (subject to global cap). Switching categories avoids penalty; no global affecting enemies elsewhere.
